legend.REDESIGNED: Changed in this redesign (R1 checkpoint or the final pass); see “what changed”.
legend.REVIEWED AND UNCHANGED: Reviewed at 1440 and 375 and kept: pixel-identical to the published V3 Faculty build, or only the surrounding redesigned page differs (scope note).

patterns.P1: Priority band sized to its items, with the people or records behind each count; ivory only for urgent work
patterns.P2: Plan-tint identity band for a record (course, experiment, assessment) with fact figures
patterns.P3: Course ledger: tinted group header, column-aligned rows, no nested cards
patterns.P4: Unit meter beside counts in words, one per format; never a percentage
patterns.P5: Reading sheet at reading width with an action panel; the final action last with its note
patterns.P6: Sectioned authoring with a guidance and facts side panel; one primary in the footer
patterns.P7: Refined table: count, filters and actions in one toolbar; compact sub-lines; phone rows without repeated labels
patterns.P8: Sparse states: get-ready steps and compact message cards sized to their content
patterns.P9: Deadlines with days left and the release rule
patterns.P10: Records are identified by their name, the student’s name, the question’s text or its position — never by an internal technical id

ownerDecision: Owner decision, 21 Oct 2026 — internal technical IDs (ASMT-, ATT-, Q-, D-) are out of every ordinary user-facing label, placeholder, dialog title, notice and accessible name. Academic course codes and institution-issued student IDs stay. Stable keys stay in routing, element ids and the question search, so no business rule changed.

owned.name: Create assessment (4 steps)
owned.whatChanged: A stepper that fits a phone (only the current step is labelled there); every step a sectioned form: experiment cards with formats and reach; name and introduction, then the three rules aligned in one row and the release options side by side; questions as checkbox cards with other ways to add below; preview as a rules list and numbered questions with type tags. The side summary ticks what is done and, at step 4, lists what happens when you create it. Questions are chosen and previewed by their text, type and marks, and the result card says the assessment is created and ready without printing its id.

subviews.note: compact message card (P8) instead of an empty step 1

owned.name: Assessment · Summary

Summary: readiness, rules as set, who it reaches; navy Submissions panel with the waiting names oldest first and one gold Mark next. Tabs scroll on a phone with the current tab kept in view. The band shows the state, version, who created it and what is waiting — not the assessment id.
